_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2015, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 24% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2015 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of enjoyable brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2015, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 24% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2015 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +78% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.52; conservative 2yr -30%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -14.1%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.9%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +2.9%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +10.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2016-04-19) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (59.7% downside to Bear $42 / +-20.4% upside to Bull $83) | Adj composite 2.25 vs market 3.77: gap -1.52 [OVERVALUED] | +78% above the EPP floor $59 (16x FY16E $3.67) | Conservative 2-yr case: -29.9% total (-15.0%/yr) | At 28.4x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $138 sits above the BULL case; servings +2.0% in Q1 2016, forward revenues +1.5% (Q1 2016 net revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
